column1: # Epistemic: measured (YAML-parsed ATen native function schemas and Core ATen IR tags across official PyTorch release tags)
# Method: scripted (parsed native_functions.yaml at each official PyTorch release tag to count '- func:' ATen schemas and 'core'-tagged Core ATen IR entries)
# Computation: aten_schemas counts top-level '- func:' entries (including overloads); core_aten counts entries carrying the 'core' tag introduced in PyTorch v2.0.0.
#   release: string [tag] — Official PyTorch GitHub release tag
#   date: date [ISO-8601 date] — GitHub release publication date
#   aten_schemas: integer [schemas] — Total top-level '- func:' ATen native function schema declarations (including overloads)
#   core_aten: integer [schemas] — Count of native function schemas carrying the Core ATen IR 'core' tag (populated from v2.0.0 onward)
# Notes: Dates record official GitHub release publication dates for each tag.
